explain XXXXX in english without using word XXXXX.

a:

as i see it, there are two questions:

is there an article that begins with "the" before any noun?
is there an article that begins with "XXXXX" before any noun?

i think that the article before a noun should always be before the noun it is modifying. so "the XXXXX" is always, according to my reading, to be the first of the three articles.
(i just checked, and "XXXXX" is the third article.)
as for XXXXX and XXXXX, that is to be defined by context. in your other question, i think that "XXXXXs" and "governing" are two different things.

a:

i would classify your example as the third option (XXXXXs is the third option). i think this also falls under the 3rd article definition.
the first option is a matter of definition (and as i mentioned above, i think it does not apply).
you have an article with the second and third nouns, which makes a difference.
however, in this case both XXXXX and governing are defined in the same article.
